rounds.review: Retraction first, because it is the one fact worth interrupting someone for, and Crossref answers it free and unmetered: 30 of 30 real library DOIs resolved on Crossref alone. A 429 from OpenAlex used to read as 'no notices found', so a sweep during an outage would have walked the whole library and reported a clean bill of health; it now keeps Crossref's verdict, marks the entry partial, and asks again next time. One run at a time, cancellable, resumable.
rounds.verification: Targeted Node/DOM tests plus a live Crossref check over real library DOIs.
